NDA information protection.reason: Section 6.4 says that a compelled disclosure does not establish the Section 3 public-information exclusion: a rule on exclusions, but no asset of Annex A was disclosed under compulsion.

NDA recipient permissions.reason: Section 8.1 is the general closed-record clause; it also says that unsigned requests and internal notes do not override the rules and that there are no other consents, which bears on telling executed consents from drafts.

NDA exit obligations X-27.reason: Section 1.2 puts the training of machine-learning models outside the Permitted Purpose, which bears on the reuse of NOTE-1; the operative restriction is in Section 5.1.
Section 1.3 says how the disclosure window is terminated, one of the two triggers of Section 7.1, and that a return request is not a termination notice; the facts of the case are in D1.1.

NDA information protection.reason: Section 1.2 has the Effective Date, which the duration rule of Section 2.5 counts from.
Section 1.3 defines the disclosure window, which Section 2.1 makes protection depend on, and says that closing the window does not change protection already attached.

NDA recipient permissions.reason: Section 1.2 defines the Permitted Purpose, which Section 4.1 makes a condition of access.
